mapper.sql: budget_pls.id AS id, budget_pls.company_id AS companyId, companies.name AS companyName, budget_pls.branch_id AS branchId, branches.name AS branchName, budget_pls.year AS `year`, budget_pls.name AS `name`, budget_pls.description AS description, DATE_FORMAT(budget_pls.created, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS createdDate, DATE_FORMAT(budget_pls.modified, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS modifiedDate, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name ) AS createdBy, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name ) AS modifiedBy

FROM budget_pls INNER JOIN companies ON companies.id = budget_pls.company_id LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = budget_pls.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = budget_pls.modified_by LEFT JOIN branches ON branches.id = budget_pls.branch_id
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(budget_pl_details.m1, 0) AS m1, IFNULL(budget_pl_details.m2, 0) AS m2, IFNULL(budget_pl_details.m3, 0) AS m3, IFNULL(budget_pl_details.m4, 0) AS m4, IFNULL(budget_pl_details.m5, 0) AS m5, IFNULL(budget_pl_details.m6, 0) AS m6, IFNULL(budget_pl_details.m7, 0) AS m7, IFNULL(budget_pl_details.m8, 0) AS m8, IFNULL(budget_pl_details.m9, 0) AS m9, IFNULL(budget_pl_details.m10, 0) AS m10, IFNULL(budget_pl_details.m11, 0) AS m11, IFNULL(budget_pl_details.m12, 0) AS m12 FROM budget_pl_details LEFT JOIN chart_accounts ON chart_accounts.id = budget_pl_details.chart_account_id WHERE budget_pl_details.budget_pl_id = #{budgetPlanId} AND chart_accounts.id = #{chartAccId} AND chart_accounts.is_active = 1

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO budget_pls( company_id, branch_id, `year`, `name`, description, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{budgetPlan.companyId}, #{budgetPlan.branchId}, #{budgetPlan.year}, #{budgetPlan.name}, #{budgetPlan.description}, NOW(), #{budgetPlan.createdBy}, #{budgetPlan.isActive} );

INSERT INTO budget_pl_details( budget_pl_id, chart_account_id, m1, m2, m3, m4, m5, m6, m7, m8, m9, m10, m11, m12 ) VALUES ( #{budgetPlanDetail.budgetPlsId}, #{budgetPlanDetail.chartAccountId}, #{budgetPlanDetail.m1}, #{budgetPlanDetail.m2}, #{budgetPlanDetail.m3}, #{budgetPlanDetail.m4}, #{budgetPlanDetail.m5}, #{budgetPlanDetail.m6}, #{budgetPlanDetail.m7}, #{budgetPlanDetail.m8}, #{budgetPlanDetail.m9}, #{budgetPlanDetail.m10}, #{budgetPlanDetail.m11}, #{budgetPlanDetail.m12} );
mapper.update: UPDATE budget_pls SET `company_id` = #{budgetPlan.companyId}, `branch_id` = #{budgetPlan.branchId}, `year` = #{budgetPlan.year}, `name` = #{budgetPlan.name}, `description` = #{budgetPlan.description}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{budgetPlan.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{budgetPlan.id}
